answer_1.quote: the text summarization community presents multilingual summarization (MLS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS), respectively... the goal of M2MS is to build a single summarization model to process a document in any source language and generate the corresponding summary in any given target language.
answer_1.outputs: summaries in the target language from input documents in the source language

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE-1/2/L and BERTSCORE in our experiments.

answer_4.quote: we conduct the human evaluation on 50 random samples extracted from WikiLingua (En⇒Zh, Zh⇒En and En⇒En, respectively). Three graduate students are invited to assess the generated summaries from three aspects: informativeness (IF), conciseness (CC) and grammaticality (GM).
answer_4.guideline: The scoring adopts a 5-point scale from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
